HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: HubSpot says to treat access tokens like passwords. Rotation has a grace window: rotate and expire later gives the old token seven days, or rotate and expire now ends it at once. The pat- prefix appears in examples but is not stated as a rule.

HUBSPOT_HUB_ID.description: HubSpot never calls it public. It is public here because the tracking snippet HubSpot tells you to paste before the closing body tag carries it to every visitor.
